integrity: Analytic theorem with an included independently runnable finite numerical checker; the checker is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Idealized exogenous factorized establishment, unlimited distances, exact finite mean, no ecological interactions; mean-only constraint causes nonattainment. Not an evolutionary stable strategy or field recommendation. The most relevant older abstracts from 1998 and 1999 could not be verified in full; broader historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain unresolved.
title: Sharp dispersal-kernel phases under exponential predator escape and a prescribed mean distance
